name: Cloudreach precision platformer kit
blurb: Everything for a side-view precision platformer in the sky: a courier with an air dash, a pinwheel that refills it, six kinds of enemy and a boss, island, cloud and temple ground, spikes, moving, crumbling and falling blocks, wind socks and vents, a letter to find in every room, checkpoints, three backdrops, dash pips and level stamps, 32 sounds and five tracks.
